name: Shirakawa Ayane
source:
Ayane, a runaway girl Sousuke encounters, hails from a well-to-do agribusiness family. Faced with an unsavory arranged marriage, she slipped away from her family and sought refuge in Tokyo.

Sousuke once rescued Ayane just in the nick of time from a group of menacing street thugs, sparking a friendship as thick as thieves between them. Now residing in a dorm, Ayane stands as a steadfast friend and ally to Sousuke in his time of need.
